title: Amidst high visa refusal rates and falling commencements, Australian government opens consultation on reforms to Genuine Student test and financial requirements
description:
At the Australian International Education Conference (AIEC) in late October, Assistant Minister for International Education Julian Hill announced that the government is considering reforms to the way prospective international students’ visa applications are assessed and to the settings under which immigration officials determine those students’ financial readiness.
